Project.Name: PL (Presentation Layer)
Project.Description: WPF-based presentation layer for the delivery management system. Provides a user interface for managers and couriers to interact with the business logic layer.

Architecture.Description: The project uses WPF with code-behind and dependency properties, following a simplified MVVM pattern with value converters and data binding.

Layer.Name: Presentation
Layer.Description: XAML views and code-behind files that define the user interface

Layer.Name: ViewModels
Layer.Description: Dependency properties and observable patterns implemented in code-behind

Layer.Name: Business Logic Interface
Layer.Description: Interfaces with the BL layer through BlApi.Factory.Get()

Component.Name: App.xaml / App.xaml.cs
Component.Description: Main application class that initializes the WPF application and defines global resources including styles, colors, and value converters.

Component.Name: MainWindow.xaml / MainWindow.xaml.cs
Component.Description: The entry point window providing user authentication for managers and couriers. Displays current system clock and handles role-based navigation.

Features.Feature: User authentication with ID and password
System clock display with observer pattern

Window.Name: OrderWindow.xaml / OrderWindow.xaml.cs
Window.Description: Window for creating new orders or viewing/updating existing orders. Displays order details, delivery history, and allows order cancellation.

Features.Feature: Create new orders with customer details
Cancel orders with optional SMS notification
Real-time order status updates via observer pattern
Display delivery history for the order

Property.Name: CurrentOrder
Property.Description: The order being displayed or edited

Modes.Mode: New order creation with empty form
Edit existing order with populated data

Window.Name: OrderListWindow.xaml / OrderListWindow.xaml.cs
Window.Description: List view for displaying and filtering orders. Supports sorting, filtering by status, and navigation to individual orders.

Features.Feature: Display all orders in a DataGrid
Filter by order status (Open, Delivering, Completed, etc.)
Filter by schedule status (OnTime, AtRisk, Late)
Filter by type of order (Standard, Fast, Immediate)
Real-time list updates via observer pattern

Window.Name: CourierWindow.xaml / CourierWindow.xaml.cs
Window.Description: Window for creating new couriers or viewing/updating existing courier details. Allows management of courier information and status.

Features.Feature: Configure shipment type (Car, Motorcycle, Bike, Foot)

Window.Name: CourierListWindow.xaml / CourierListWindow.xaml.cs
Window.Description: List view for displaying and managing couriers. Supports filtering by active status and sorting.

Features.Feature: Display all couriers in a list
Sort by various fields (Name, ID, Phone, etc.)

Window.Name: MainCourier.xaml / MainCourier.xaml.cs
Window.Description: Main dashboard for logged-in couriers. Displays available orders, current deliveries, and delivery history.

Features.Feature: View available orders matching courier capabilities

Window.Name: CourierDeliveryHistoryWindow.xaml / CourierDeliveryHistoryWindow.xaml.cs
Window.Description: Displays complete delivery history for a specific courier with filtering options.

Window.Name: StartDeliveryWindow.xaml / StartDeliveryWindow.xaml.cs
Window.Description: Window for assigning orders to couriers and initiating deliveries.

Features.Feature: Select order from open orders list
Select available courier based on capabilities

Window.Name: CloseDeliveryWindow.xaml / CloseDeliveryWindow.xaml.cs
Window.Description: Window for completing or failing active deliveries.

Window.Name: MapPopupWindow.xaml / MapPopupWindow.xaml.cs
Window.Description: Popup window displaying delivery location on a map.

Features.Feature: Display delivery address on Google Maps
Show route from store to delivery location

Window.Name: ManagerWindow.xaml / ManagerWindow.xaml.cs
Window.Description: Main dashboard for manager users. Provides access to all system management features.

Window.Name: ConfigWindow.xaml / ConfigWindow.xaml.cs
Window.Description: System configuration window for managing operational parameters.

Features.Feature: Configure average speeds for different vehicle types
Configure risk range for late deliveries
Manage API keys and external service credentials

Helper.Name: Tools
Helper.Description: Provides utility methods and helper functions used throughout the PL project.

Method.Name: OpenOrActivateWindow<T>
Method.Description: Opens a new window or activates an existing one of the specified type. Supports owner windows and predicates for matching existing windows.

Parameter.Name: matchPredicate
Parameter.Description: Optional predicate to match existing windows

Method.Name: SetSoftOwner
Method.Description: Extension method to set a soft owner relationship between windows (centers child, closes child when parent closes).

Method.Name: GetDescription
Method.Description: Extension method to get the Description attribute value from enum values.

Method.Name: GetEnumList<T>
Method.Description: Converts enum values to a list of SelectionItems for ComboBox binding with Hebrew descriptions.

Method.Name: GetSafeFromBl<T>
Method.Description: Safely executes a BL function and returns default value on exception.

Method.Name: RunSafe
Method.Description: Safely executes an action and displays error message box on exception.

Method.Name: TriggerReset
Method.Description: Triggers the ResetRequested event to notify all windows of a database reset.

Property.Name: NumericOnly
Property.Description: Attached property to restrict TextBox input to numeric values only

Property.Name: MoveFocusTo
Property.Description: Attached property to move focus to another control when Enter is pressed

Class.Name: RelayCommand
Class.Description: Implementation of ICommand for MVVM command binding.

Class.Name: SelectionItem
Class.Description: Data transfer object for ComboBox items with ID and display name.

Helper.Name: Converters
Helper.Description: Collection of IValueConverter implementations for XAML data binding conversions.

Converter.Name: EnumToBooleanConverter
Converter.Description: Converts enum values to boolean for RadioButton binding
Converter.Usage: RadioButton IsChecked binding with enum properties

Converter.Name: NullToVisibilityConverter
Converter.Description: Converts null/empty values to Visibility (Collapsed for null, Visible for not null)

Converter.Name: NullToBooleanConverter
Converter.Description: Returns true if value is null, false otherwise

Converter.Name: ValueToHebrewConverter
Converter.Description: Converts English string values to Hebrew equivalents

Converter.Name: EnumDescriptionConverter
Converter.Description: Converts enum values to their Description attribute text
Converter.Usage: Display enum values with Hebrew descriptions

Converter.Name: TotalHoursConverter
Converter.Description: Converts TimeSpan to total hours as integer

Converter.Name: SpanTimeConverter
Converter.Description: Bidirectional converter between TimeSpan and "DD:HH" format string

Converter.Name: TimeSpanToShortStringConverter
Converter.Description: Converts TimeSpan to user-friendly Hebrew text

Converter.Name: NullToSizeConverter
Converter.Description: Returns different size values based on null/not-null

Property.Name: NullSize
Property.Description: Size to return when value is null

Property.Name: NotNullSize
Property.Description: Size to return when value is not null

Converter.Name: OrderStatusToCancelConverter
Converter.Description: Determines if cancel button should be enabled based on order status

Converter.Name: OrderStatusToVisibilityConverter
Converter.Description: Shows SMS checkbox only for DELIVERING status

Converter.Name: RunStopSimulatorConverter
Converter.Description: Converts simulator running state to Hebrew button text

Converter.Name: StatusToColorConverter
Converter.Description: Converts various status values to background colors

Helper.Name: ObserverMutex
Helper.Description: Provides thread-safe synchronization for observer pattern updates in WPF. Prevents race conditions when multiple observer notifications occur.

Method.Name: CheckAndSetLoadInProgressOrRestartRequired
Method.Description: Checks if update is in progress and sets flag. Returns true if update should be skipped.

Method.Name: UnsetLoadInProgressAndCheckRestartRequested
Method.Description: Clears in-progress flag and returns true if another update was requested during execution.

Helper.Usage: Used in observer callbacks to prevent concurrent UI updates

Helper.Name: UserControlTools
Helper.Description: Custom user control providing reusable UI components.

Interface.Name: IWindowUpdater
Interface.Description: Interface for windows that support state updates without closing and reopening.

Method.Name: UpdateState
Method.Description: Updates the window's state with provided arguments when window is reactivated instead of creating new instance.

Interface.Usage: Implemented by windows that should update their content when activated from OpenOrActivateWindow

Enum.Name: CourierFieldSort
Enum.Description: Wrapper class providing IEnumerable access to BO.CourierFieldSort enum for XAML binding.
Enum.Usage: ComboBox ItemsSource for courier sorting options

Enum.Name: CourierFieldFilter
Enum.Description: Wrapper class for BO.CourierFieldFilter enum (All, IsActive, InActive).
Enum.Usage: ComboBox ItemsSource for courier filtering options

Enum.Name: OrderFilterScheduleStatus
Enum.Description: Wrapper for BO.ScheduleStatus with nullable support for "All" option.

Enum.Name: OrderStatusFilterOptions
Enum.Description: Wrapper for BO.OrderStatus with nullable support for "All" option.

Enum.Name: SelectionItem
Enum.Description: Data transfer object for ComboBox items (duplicate of Tools.SelectionItem).

ObserverPattern.Description: The PL project extensively uses the Observer pattern for real-time UI updates.

Observer.Name: Clock Observer
Observer.Purpose: Updates UI with current system clock
Observer.Usage: MainWindow, OrderWindow, and other time-sensitive displays

Observer.Name: Order Observer
Observer.Purpose: Updates UI when specific order changes
Observer.Usage: OrderWindow for real-time order status updates

Observer.Name: List Observers
Observer.Purpose: Updates lists when items are added/removed/changed

ThreadSafety.Description: All observers use ObserverMutex to prevent race conditions
ThreadSafety.Pattern: Dispatcher.BeginInvoke with async/await for UI thread marshalling

DataBinding.Description: The project uses extensive WPF data binding with dependency properties and value converters.

Pattern.Name: Conditional Visibility
Pattern.Usage: Show/hide UI elements based on data

Styling.Description: Consistent styling using StaticResource references to global ResourceDictionary.

ErrorHandling.Strategy: Try-catch blocks with user-friendly Hebrew error messages

Pattern.Name: Safe BL Access
Pattern.Description: Wraps BL calls with exception handling and default value return

Pattern.Name: Safe Action Execution
Pattern.Description: Wraps void actions with exception handling and MessageBox display

Pattern.Name: Specific Exception Handling
Pattern.Description: Catch specific BO exceptions (BlDoesNotExistException, BlInvalidValueException, etc.) and display appropriate messages

Practice.Name: Window Lifecycle Management
Practice.Description: Subscribe to observers in Window_Loaded, unsubscribe in Window_Closed to prevent memory leaks

Practice.Name: Thread Safety
Practice.Description: Use ObserverMutex for observer callbacks, Dispatcher.BeginInvoke for UI thread access

Practice.Name: Resource Cleanup
Practice.Description: Always unsubscribe from events and remove observers when window closes

Practice.Name: Null Safety
Practice.Description: Use null-conditional operators (?.) and null-coalescing operators (??) throughout

Practice.Name: Localization Ready
Practice.Description: All user-facing strings in Hebrew, enum descriptions use Description attributes

Practice.Name: Single Responsibility
Practice.Description: Each window has a clear, focused purpose

Practice.Name: Reusable Components
Practice.Description: Converters, helpers, and attached properties promote code reuse

Feature.Name: Real-time Updates
Feature.Description: Observer pattern ensures UI automatically reflects backend changes without manual refresh

Feature.Name: Role-based Access
Feature.Description: Different interfaces for managers vs couriers with appropriate permissions

Feature.Name: Delivery Simulation
Feature.Description: Manager can start/stop simulator and control system clock for testing

Feature.Name: Interactive Maps
Feature.Description: Google Maps integration for delivery location visualization

Feature.Name: Comprehensive Filtering
Feature.Description: Advanced filtering and sorting options for orders and couriers

Feature.Name: Address Geocoding
Feature.Description: Automatic conversion of addresses to coordinates using Google Geocoding API

Feature.Name: SMS Notifications
Feature.Description: Optional SMS alerts for couriers when orders are cancelled

Feature.Name: Status Color Coding
Feature.Description: Visual feedback through colored backgrounds based on status

Improvement.Name: Full MVVM Implementation
Improvement.Description: Move logic from code-behind to dedicated ViewModel classes

Improvement.Name: Dependency Injection
Improvement.Description: Use DI container for better testability and decoupling

Improvement.Name: Unit Testing
Improvement.Description: Add unit tests for converters, commands, and business logic

Improvement.Name: Localization
Improvement.Description: Support multiple languages using resource files

Improvement.Name: Accessibility
Improvement.Description: Improve keyboard navigation and screen reader support

Improvement.Name: Responsive Design
Improvement.Description: Better handling of different screen sizes and resolutions

Notes.Note: The project follows Hebrew right-to-left flow direction throughout
All error messages and user-facing text are in Hebrew
The project uses .NET 8.0 and C# 12.0 features including primary constructors, required properties, and global usings
Thread safety is a priority with ObserverMutex pattern used extensively
The codebase includes comprehensive XML documentation comments in English for future developers
